assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG prop for the web app Object Court, matching the supplied blue bottle mascot.
Input images: Image 1 is a STYLE reference ONLY. Match its premium soft matte resin toy finish, softly rounded sculpted forms, muted navy and warm cream accents, gentle studio lighting and delicate ambient occlusion. Do not include the bottle or any character.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no scenery, floor, shadow plane, solid background or checkerboard.
Constraints: one isolated complete prop composition, generous empty margins on all sides, no text, logos, labels, watermark, face, eyes, decorations, border or pedestal. Clean silhouette readable at 120 pixels. No thick dark outlines, shiny plastic or realistic skin/wood textures.
Primary request: a symmetrical pair of cupped open toy hands, warm ivory ceramic / matte resin, with short dark navy cuffs at the wrists. Palms face upward and slightly toward the camera, gently supporting an EMPTY central space where an object will later be placed in the app. The two hands form one shallow cradle, thumbs gently toward the sides, a few softly modeled finger separations. All fingers and wrists visible. Friendly minimal sculpted anatomy, no realistic veins or skin creases. No arms beyond the short cuffs. Composition: wide landscape 3:2, front view with a little view into the palms; hands sit in the lower two thirds of the canvas. No object in or over the hands.
assets.refinementPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: production transparent PNG prop.
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target, the pair of ivory matte toy hands.
Primary request: remove ONLY all surrounding glow, mist, bloom, halo, haze and aura OUTSIDE the hands and cuffs. Every background pixel beyond the true hand/cuff silhouette must be fully transparent. Keep clean precise gently anti-aliased cutout edges without feathering.
Preserve EXACTLY the pair of cupped ivory hands, finger arrangement, sculpted surfaces, soft shading INSIDE the hands, navy cuffs, colors, lighting, camera, wide 3:2 composition and scale. No new objects or retouching inside the hands. No text or watermark. True transparent alpha background.
